description.value:
You channel the Force into a surge of martial fury. For the duration, you cannot cast powers, but you gain the following: 50 temporary hit points (any that remain when the power ends are lost); advantage on attack rolls made with lightweapons and vibroweapons; an extra 2d12 force damage whenever a weapon attack of yours connects; proficiency with all armor, lightweapons, and vibroweapons; proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws; and the ability to attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action (this doesn't stack with an existing extra-attack feature).

The instant the power ends, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or gain one level of exhaustion.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 6
